text:
kira: Quick sync - need final copy for launch posts + benchmark narrative A/B before we publish. Also locking rehearsal slots and speaker ops. goal: drive trial signups and highlight cost/latency wins.

ana: Two narrative buckets we tested in the draft: (1) Cost-first (savings, quantization, batching) and (2) Performance-first (latency, reliability, fallbacks). Which should lead socials?

jamal: My vote: mix but lead with cost-first on paid/social ads (clear hook), performance-first on technical threads and speaker quotes. That helps target PLG vs platform buyers.

emily: Agreed. For organic posts we'll A/B test headlines for first 24h. need three headlines per variant and two creatives each.

ben: Creative ask: design wants 2 hero images (cost bar chart vs latency waveform) + 1 short clip (10s) showing dashboard change. ETA 48h.

steve: Speaker ops: ask speakers to prepare two benchmark slides: one that shows % cost delta across quantization configs, one showing p95/p99 latency under load. keep raw numbers anonymized if customer data.

kira: good. jamal can you paste the sample social copy variants?

jamal: paste below (keep tight):

```
A1 (cost-first): "Cut per-token costs without slower UX. Join Redwood engineers for benchmarks & playbooks. May 15. Sign up."
A2 (cost-first teaser): "How one tweak saved 30% on inference cost. Live benchmarks May 15."
A3 (cost-first developer): "Batching, quantization, caching: small levers, big savings. Webinar."

B1 (perf-first): "Keep latency tight at scale. Learn routing & fallback strategies from the field."
B2 (perf-first ops): "Meet SRE-friendly approaches to predictable LLM serving. Live demo + Q&A."
B3 (perf-first technical): "p99 matters: engineering practices to avoid noisy tails. Join us."
```

emily: Email subject variants (A/B across narrative):
- A: "Webinar: Cut LLM costs—benchmarks & playbook"
- B: "Webinar: Avoid latency surprises at scale"

ben: Paid ad tip: headline must be <30 chars for platform limits. Also include a trial-cta in body: "Claim trial credit".

kira: landing language: use product-focused hero (cost-first) + a small subhead: "Live benchmarks + practical playbook". Add a second CTA for enterprise walk-through (sales).

ana: run-of-show draft (45m):

```
00:00-00:03  Host welcome + agenda
00:03-00:10  Why cost & perf both matter (jamal)
00:10-00:22  Benchmarks & tactics (zara remote guest)
00:22-00:30  Demo: dashboard + routing change (live)
00:30-00:40  Customer micro-case + lessons learned
00:40-00:45  Q&A + CTA
```

steve: rehearsal ops checklist:
- Speaker slides due 72h prior (2 benchmark slides + contingency slide)
- Full dry run 48h prior (45m) with host + speakers + ops
- Tech check 1h prior (AV + OBS scenes)
- Contingency micro-sim 2h prior (infra)

kira: sample tweet thread for technical audience (to schedule):

"Thread start: Benchmarks matter. We measured X across quant configs -> here's what moved the needle. (1/5)"
followed by short bullets with chart images.

ben: design-bot: uploading hero comps and 10s clip to drive now.

design-bot: design-bot: assets uploaded -> https://drive.redwood/webinars/assets/practical-inference/ (hero-1.png, hero-2.png, clip10s.mp4)

emily: cadence plan: organic posts D-14, D-7, D-3, D-1, day-of reminder. Paid ads start D-10. Email drip: initial, 7d reminder, 24h reminder, 1h reminder.

jamal: A/B testing plan: split paid/social audience 50/50 across A/B headlines for first 24h, measure CTR -> favor winner for remainder. report to growth channel 48h post-launch.

kira: tracking requirements: ensure registration form captures trial checkbox + role + utm + narrative_variant (A or B). jamal pls wire landing form param so we can map variant.

jamal: will add hidden field narrative_variant set by ad/social link param. example: /signup?utm=webinar0515&variant=A

ana: speaker prep notes for zara & jamal: please keep one bullet slide with "what to say if demo fails" and the host script line: "If we switch demo models mid-demo, you'll still see the same features; this is expected during scale tests."

steve: calendar-bot: scheduling rehearsals now.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: events created -> "Practical Inference - Dry Run" 2024-05-13 09:00 PT, "Practical Inference - Tech Check" 2024-05-15 09:00 PT. Invites sent.

ben: final creative ask: make two versions of the hero: one with a bold % savings callout, one with a subtle latency badge. we'll surface both in the A/B.

kira: action items recap (assign):
- jamal: wire landing hidden variants + finalize social copy (due 48h)
- ben/design: deliver hero + clip (due 48h)
- steve/ops: run contingency micro-sim + confirm infra (due 48h)
- emily: build email drip + schedule (due 72h)
- speakers: slides in drive incl. contingency bullet (due 72h)

kira: thanks all — let's reconvene here 48h with status. closing thread. :rocket:
